title: Recover exactly verified confirmed approvals without transaction resubmission
trigger: Accountant round 3 stopped at a revised approval, scored 12/20 and reported AC-R3-001 through 003. User then explicitly authorized up to two additional iterations under the existing budget. UX /root/build_ux proposed bounded reconciliation and recovery presentation; PM /root/build_pm prioritized the blocker; SDE /root/build_sde supplied the exact approval-only feasible contract; independent tester /root/integration_test supplied recovery-test-matrix.md; PM accepts after one engineering round. Browser symptoms and parent-reported confirmed transaction diagnosis are distinct evidence sources. This is controller-attested negotiation, not an isolated browser-worker receipt.
productRationale: A status-check control must be able to recognize an already confirmed approval safely rather than leave the accountant permanently blocked. The observed case requires approval recovery, so accept automatic recovery only for a successfully confirmed exactly matching approve action. Honest locked-state guidance is sufficient for unsupported operations in this bounded iteration. Operation-specific wording, unresolved evidence context and responsive identifier display are necessary to make recovery understandable. The original approval/credit/payment invariant and no-duplicate protections remain unchanged.
engineeringDecision: Accept the original proposal as bounded by SDE's explicit supported-transition contract, with no engineering counterproposal or unresolved objection. Automatic reconciliation is APPROVAL ONLY; credit, pay, reset, capture and expected-failed replay remain locked and operator-assisted. Before any broadcast, await durable preparation binding signed bytes/hash, signature, blockhash, last-valid height, kind and canonical handle to the existing private intent. Reconciliation runs through the Engine action queue, uses read-only confirmed base64 transaction inspection and sufficiently fresh canonical account reads, independently reconstructs the exact approve message, verifies its sole permitted business effect and exact expected account transition, validates the legal intended local delta and atomically commits that result with request idempotency and pending removal. It never signs or sends. Legacy journal binding is separate controller-attested migration with exact evidence and backup, not pre-submission capture. No program or ledger-authority changes are accepted.
constraints: This is overall cycle 3, the first of at most two newly authorized iterations. Cycle 4 is allowed only if necessary findings remain after fresh review. The original two UI cycles remain complete. Same shared $10 total additional-expense ceiling, not a new allotment. Parent remains sole control-plane writer, budget owner and legacy-migration authority. Persist this decision before disjoint implementation; approvedImplementationTasks remains empty until canonical task assignment.

Automatic recovery supports a successful approve action only. Credit, payment, reset, capture, failed stale-replay and failed transactions remain locked with explicit operator-assistance wording; no retry, manual override, cancellation or reset-to-unlock control. Do not describe this implementation as automatic credit/payment recovery. Further transition support requires separately accepted engineering scope.

Preparation must atomically attach exact transaction identity to the exact existing pendingIntent before any send; persistence failure aborts broadcast. Keep request id, fingerprint, actor, scenario, before and intendedAfter durable. Never derive authority from pasted signatures, error-message parsing, generic confirmation or the parent-provided signature alone. Public metadata excludes keys, signed bytes and private snapshots.

Use confirmed getTransaction base64 evidence with metadata err null, valid slot, exact signed-byte/hash equality and verified signatures. Independently reconstruct the expected compiled message with saved blockhash and configured actor fee payer/signer. Permit only the validated compute-unit-limit instruction and one exact Kontor approve instruction. Validate tag, revision, canonical config/obligation/revision accounts; reject extra transfers/instructions, foreign programs, extra accounts and ambiguous versions. Compiled privilege normalization must follow message reconstruction, not naive deserialized writability comparison.

Read canonical program state at minContextSlot at least the confirmed transaction slot. Require exactly the expected actor approval-bit delta, unchanged revision, amount, mint, recipient, documents and authorization terms, valid approval expiry and paid false. The actor must not already be approved in before state. Additional later approvals, advanced revision, paid state, altered terms or expired readiness remain unsupported rather than silently merged. Validate owner/size/PDA and existing link rules. Approval proof cannot establish Test USD transfer; network fees are distinct.

Validate intendedAfter as precisely the legal approval delta and one original matching evidence event, preserving prior prefixes/IDs, invoice/credit data and settlement null. Allow only existing second-approval previousInstruction behavior. Reject unrelated local mutation. Atomically save confirmed state, exact proof, original event IDs, request-id/fingerprint idempotency and pending removal. Auxiliary-proof failure cannot clear the authoritative lock. Repeated/concurrent checks, restart and original request retries must not create an approval, evidence event, signature or transaction again.

For the current legacy interruption, parent may bind a uniquely verified historical journal only to an already durable matching intent after exact action/actor/obligation/revision/time and successful chain evidence agree. Preserve backup and provenance explicitly as controller-attested legacy binding. Missing intent, conflicting journals or unverifiable identity remains locked; never fabricate original intent. Parent should verify and reconcile this existing obligation before creating another scenario.

Unknown, failed, unseen, unconfirmed, malformed, rate-limited, stale-read, mismatched and ambiguous outcomes retain accounting state and operation lock. A bounded manual status check may update only honest last-result/time metadata while unresolved. Reconcile shares the serialized action queue and cannot race a new action across a scenario or revision. No signing, broadcast, resend, replacement blockhash or RPC sendTransaction is reachable from recovery.

Recovery names the saved operation, actor and amount and distinguishes approval confirmation from funds movement. Show non-overlapping checking state and latest result/time, explain why unresolved actions stay locked, and use an honest generic fallback for missing identity. Place one actual signature in a wrapping accessible disclosure/copy field. At desktop and 390 px, banners and payment rail must fit the viewport. No infinite polling, scheduling or unsupported escalation button.

Display unresolved operation context separately from immutable completed events. Only verified recovery promotes it into its actual original confirmed record. Preserve existing and archived evidence and original exports. No fabricated receipt, payment claim or confirmed event while uncertainty remains.

Run typecheck/build and the independent recovery matrix as adapted to this approval-only SDE contract: exact first/second approval, no-send/sign spy, repeated/concurrent checks, restart before/after, persistence failure, signature/bytes/hash/action/actor/account/revision mismatch, extra instruction, illegal intendedAfter, stale/advanced/expired state and failed/unseen/unconfirmed/RPC lock retention. Unsupported action types must explicitly reject. Validate actual stuck-scenario before/after identity read-only separately from controlled fixtures. Record exact test evidence and limitations.

After implementation run fresh-context desktop/390 px accountant verification of meaningful recovery, accurate pending explanation, no overflow and continued workflow completion. Avoid extra payments/resets solely for layout. Fresh browser review remains instructionally isolated, not technically isolated; orchestration fixtures, source-aware network checks and accountant observations must be reported separately. Do not claim a new SBF audit or production accounting acceptance. Printable exports and broad visual/accessibility redesign remain deferred.
rejectedAlternatives: Cosmetic recovery copy without functional Check status: leaves the observed confirmed approval unable to complete the workflow.
Generic promotion of intendedAfter on any successful signature or matching approval mask: does not prove exact transaction identity or the permitted local transition.
Automatic credit/payment recovery in this iteration: lacks separately specified and tested transition proof; approval-only addresses the actual interruption.
Resend, replace transaction, retry payment/approval or reset-to-unlock: risks duplicate operations and bypasses uncertainty protection.
Silently merge later chain state or expired readiness: exceeds the exact bounded transition and can misrepresent current authorization.
Describe historical journal attachment as durable pre-submission capture: obscures provenance; legacy binding must remain controller-attested.
Treat a cleared lock, optimistic UI or parent's manual diagnosis alone as recovery evidence: authoritative verified transaction and state binding must precede the atomic commit.
Automatically spend a new budget or always run a fourth cycle: user authorized the same expense ceiling and a fourth iteration only if needed.
